name: Question 1
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/87d71379739f4abfe7f47f31448f5245bdfba8d6986d5746a3deb67f49acabef.png)

What division problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{1}{5}$ on the left and $\frac{1}{15}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/bafb6b86ebc3c330d202cb340c7d7a5fbea2982e689bc9e8c8cbce74e50d49fe.png)

Therefore, the division problem shown is

$$
\frac{1}{5}÷3=\frac{1}{15}.
$$
